settings.heading: Build a mixed box
settings.body: Six tins, any split of Mint and Citrus. Same electrolytes in both — pick on taste.
settings.note: Mixed boxes add one tin at a time, so they use the single-tin price. Same-flavor 3-packs and 6-packs save more.

settings.heading: Want one flavor, not a mix?
settings.body: A same-flavor 6-pack is $71.40 instead of six loose tins. Subscriptions take another 15% off.
